concept.concept: Illustrated dog dressed as a tiny ghost with 'My Dog is the Cutest Spooky' in hand-lettered style
concept.audience: Dog owners who dress their pets for Halloween and share photos on social media
concept.rationale: Pet Halloween content explodes in September-October. Dog owner niche is massive, emotionally engaged, and buys heavily. Avoids all IP. Humor plus cute art style is proven to convert. High shareability drives organic reach.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "My Dog is the Cutest Spooky" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a friendly cartoon dog wearing a white ghost costume with two black oval eyes and a simple curved smile. The dog's ears poke out from under the white sheet. Dog is centered in composition. Use solid color blocks: white ghost, warm tan dog ears/snout, black eyes and smile, orange background. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Bold screen-print aesthetic with clean sharp edges and high contrast. Single centered composition with generous margin on plain solid orange background. Design readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design: My Dog is the Cutest Spooky
design.style: Hand-lettered style arched in a curved banner below the illustration, friendly casual serif with slight irregularity to suggest hand-drawn quality. Bold weight, black color, integrated into the flat vector design.

verdict.reason: The phrase 'My Dog is the Cutest Spooky' is a generic, descriptive sentiment with no known trademark associations. The illustrated concept of a dog dressed as a ghost is a common Halloween novelty theme. No celebrity likenesses, brand names, protected characters, registered slogans, or song lyrics are referenced. The design is original and presents minimal IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads exactly 'MY DOG IS THE CUTEST SPOOKY' — correctly spelled and complete. The design features a clean, original illustration of a dog dressed as a ghost on a solid orange background. No IP conflicts, no quality issues, no anatomical problems, and no rendering artifacts detected.
